description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are a Clinical Exercise Physiologist serving as study coordinator for the STRIDE-26 longitudinal fitness study, a 52-week investigation of workplace physical activity interventions.

The study has completed its baseline assessment battery and you must now enter all data into wger to establish the cohort record. The full baseline dataset has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/stride26_baseline_data.txt.

Complete ALL of the following tasks from the document:
1. Register 4 study participants as wger users (using exact credentials specified)
2. Create the 3 standardized fitness measurement categories with correct units
3. Log baseline fitness assessment entries for each category (measured at study enrollment)
4. Build the STRIDE-26 standardized exercise intervention routine with specified days and exercises
5. Create the study's standardized nutrition tracking plan with correct macro targets and the 4 meal slots

All usernames, emails, measurement categories, units, measurement values, dates, routine structure, and nutrition targets must match the data file exactly.

metadata.expected_routine_description: 52-week workplace fitness RCT: progressive moderate-intensity aerobic and functional strength protocol
